subject: Server function: how to modify the input object

messages.author: 3fd19fd766bba142
messages.subject: Server function: how to modify the input object
parts:
Hi,

I have some issues with "ghost data" improperly lingering around when using rhandsontable. The problem is described here https://github.com/jrowen/rhandsontable/issues/85 if you want to read more. In case this problem is inherent to rhandsontable design, I think that I can devise a workaround by manipulating the input object in an observeEvent call.

A naive attempt to use input$myrhandsontable$params$data <- something in my server function returned an error message about input being read-only.

Is there a way to coerce Shiny in modifying the input object?

Thanks
